script_text: Stop, Aries — the stars are putting a brake on your fire before you charge into the wrong battle. Mars, your ruling planet, is conjunct Saturn at your 1st House cusp, while Saturn in the 12th House squares the Sun in the 3rd House, so your words need precision, not heat. As a Mars-ruled fire sign, you feel the delay personally. In love, if you’re taken, a private insecurity may surface around family or a past promise; if single, you attract someone serious, reserved, and protective. For career and money, Venus in your 2nd House trines Mercury in the 4th House, pointing to a profitable home-based deal, renegotiated rent, or payment from a family contact. Avoid signing anything while irritated, because Mars-Saturn can turn impatience into a costly delay, but one quiet conversation protects your reputation. Follow now for tomorrow’s reading.
